basis: Follow-up to acceptance 1211 and probes 1215-1234. Test one shorter causal gate: immediate-response MERGE is allowed only when LEFT itself introduces the problem/request, not when LEFT is already the completed solution. Mechanical/object completion remains a separate rule.

cases.left: A parent finishes setting breakfast on the table.
cases.right: A stranger suddenly smashes the front window and climbs inside.

cases.left: A stranger suddenly smashes the front window and climbs inside.
cases.right: The parent immediately ushers the children into a locked safe room.

cases.left: The parent gets the children inside the safe room and locks its door.
cases.right: The parent retrieves a pistol and a sword from a hidden cabinet.

cases.left: The parent retrieves a pistol and a sword from a hidden cabinet.
cases.right: The parent holsters the pistol and straps on the sword.

cases.left: The defender defeats the final attacker and the immediate threat is over.
cases.right: The defender unlocks the safe room and releases the people inside.

cases.left: The ranger gets the villagers into the stone refuge and bars the door.
cases.right: The ranger fetches a bow and quiver from the armory.
